latest_release.name: V3.18.0 Haven
latest_release.body:
Pake V3.18.0

Turn any webpage into a desktop app with one command.

### Changelog 1. Downloads on Windows now show the native WebView2 download panel with progress, and same-site downloads go through it too. 2. Dragging files onto a page to upload them now always works. `--enable-drag-drop` used to block those drops, and on Windows it also broke drag and drop inside pages; it is now accepted but ignored, so existing build commands keep working. 3. Downloaded files keep their real names, so a link to `Annual Report.pdf` or `报告.pdf` is no longer saved as `Annual%20Report.pdf` or `%E6%8A%A5%E5%91%8A.pdf`. 4. The tray menu follows the system language, with Simplified and Traditional Chinese labels. 5. After a failed build on Windows, the next build starts normally instead of stopping on a leftover compilation cache lock. 6. Apps built without `--icon` get the new flat mother-and-baby icon, the same one Pake for Mac and Windows uses. 7. Dependencies are updated for published RustSec and npm security advisories. 8. The docs now live at [pake.run](https://pake.run), with a step-by-step getting started tutorial and pages for shortcuts, scripts and AI agents. ### 更新日志 1. Windows 上下载文件会显示 WebView2 自带的下载面板和进度，同一网站内的下载也走这个面板。 2. 把文件拖到网页上上传现在都能正常用了，以前加了 `--enable-drag-drop` 反而会拦下这些文件，Windows 上网页里的拖拽也会失效，这个参数现在保留但不再生效，已有的打包命令照常能用。 3. 下载的文件保留原来的名字，`Annual Report.pdf` 或 `报告.pdf` 这样的链接不会再存成 `Annual%20Report.pdf`、`%E6%8A%A5%E5%91%8A.pdf`。 4. 托盘菜单跟随系统语言，中文系统上显示简体或繁体中文。 5. Windows 上构建失败后，下一次构建能正常开始，不会再被残留的编译缓存锁挡住。 6. 没有指定 `--icon` 时，应用默认用新的扁平母婴图标，和 Pake 桌面版用的是同一个。 7. 依赖已按公开的 RustSec 和 npm 安全公告更新。 8. 文档搬到了 [pake.run](https://pake.run)，新增一步步的入门教程，以及快捷键、脚本和 AI Agent 相关的页面。 Special thanks to @WavesMan, @NgoQuocViet2001, and @jakero for the pull requests behind this release. If Pake helps you, please consider giving it a star and recommending it to your friends. > https://github.com/tw93/Pake
